title: Block TV library fallback show names
summary: TV naming now fails closed when the parser would use a TV library/root label as the show name.
reason: Root-level TV files with weak season/episode names could fall back to labels like TV or a TV library name, producing output paths such as TV/TV/Season 04.
behavior_before: TV parsing could accept the active TV root or library label as a reliable show name when no better show title was found.
behavior_after: TV parsing rejects generic TV labels and active TV library/root labels as show names, while explicit show titles and show-folder fallbacks remain valid.
tests_added: Invoke-NamingSupportChecks.ps1 covers root-level Re:Zero ordinal-season parsing, blocked TV-root fallback, and valid show-folder fallback.
Invoke-PipelineProcessingPreflightChecks.ps1 asserts runtime TV parse preflight forwards library evidence into Get-TVInfoFromFile.
rollback_plan: Revert the TV parser fallback guard, context plumbing, rerun planning helper, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
